title: A Orchard for the Regiment
author: Xanthe Ravensworth
blurb: Rosalind Zhou, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
